What is a Cold Wallet?

A cold wallet is the most secure method for storing cryptocurrencies. Unlike hot wallets connected to the internet, cold wallet storage keeps your private keys completely offline, providing maximum protection against hacking attempts, malware, and unauthorized access.

Frequently Asked Questions - Tangem Cold Wallet

Tangem cold wallet is a secure hardware wallet that stores your cryptocurrency private keys offline using advanced NFC technology. It supports Bitcoin, Ethereum, and over 1000 digital assets with military-grade security. The wallet works by keeping your private keys completely offline while allowing convenient access through NFC-enabled smartphones.

Yes, Tangem cold wallet is significantly safer than online wallets because it keeps your private keys completely offline, eliminating risks from hacking, malware, phishing attacks, and unauthorized access. Online wallets are constantly connected to the internet, making them vulnerable to cyber attacks.

Tangem wallets support Bitcoin (BTC), Ethereum (ETH), USDT, USDC, Binance Coin (BNB), Cardano (ADA), Polygon (MATIC), and over 1000 other cryptocurrencies including DeFi tokens, NFTs, and stablecoins. The wallet is regularly updated to support new blockchain networks and tokens.

Setting up Tangem cold wallet is simple: 1) Download the official Tangem app from App Store or Google Play, 2) Tap your Tangem card to your NFC-enabled phone, 3) Follow the app instructions to create your wallet, 4) Set up backup options, 5) Start transferring your cryptocurrencies securely. The entire process takes less than 10 minutes.

If you lose your Tangem wallet card, you can recover your assets using your backup seed phrase or secondary Tangem cards if configured. It's recommended to have multiple backup cards and store your recovery phrase securely. The Tangem app provides detailed recovery instructions.

Yes, Tangem cold wallet is fully compatible with DeFi protocols and Web3 applications. You can securely interact with decentralized exchanges (DEXs), lending platforms, yield farming protocols, and dApps while maintaining complete control of your private keys.

NFC (Near Field Communication) technology in Tangem wallets allows secure, contactless communication between your wallet card and smartphone. Simply tap the card to your phone to access your wallet, sign transactions, or check balances. The NFC chip contains your encrypted private keys and never leaves the card.

Cold wallet Tangem offers military-grade security including: offline private key storage, tamper-proof hardware design, secure element chip protection, PIN code access, biometric authentication options, multi-signature support, and regular security audits by independent firms.

Tangem com offers competitive pricing for their cold wallet solutions. The basic Tangem wallet starts at affordable prices with no monthly fees. There are also multi-card packages available for enhanced security and backup options. Check the official website for current pricing and promotions.

Yes, you can easily transfer cryptocurrencies from any exchange (Binance, Coinbase, Kraken, etc.) to your Tangem cold wallet. Simply copy your wallet address from the Tangem app and use it as the withdrawal address on your exchange. Always verify the address before confirming transfers.

Tangem is available in over 50 countries worldwide with international shipping options. The wallet supports multiple languages and currencies. Customer support is available 24/7 in multiple languages to assist users globally.

Transactions with Tangem wallets are processed instantly on the device level. The actual blockchain confirmation time depends on the network (Bitcoin: 10-60 minutes, Ethereum: 1-5 minutes). The NFC tap-to-sign process takes less than 2 seconds, making it one of the fastest cold wallet solutions available.
